digest.component_or_area: terraform-drift CI workflow and Gerrit integration
propositions: Terraform drift check does not run for Gerrit changes pre-submit because workflow triggers only on pull_request and push to main, allowing unapplied infrastructure to land and turn main red post-merge
A Verified +1 gate on a terraform change does not signal that declared infrastructure actually exists in the cloud, creating a false confidence for reviewers
The 34cd change added CloudWatch alarm resource in HCL that was never applied to AWS, discovered only after landing via the post-merge drift check failure
Manual terraform apply step is folklore rather than documented, creating process gap where authors do not consistently apply changes before or after submit
Pre-submit drift detection must distinguish between a change's own not-yet-applied additions versus previously-committed unapplied HCL to avoid false failures on every terraform change
